name: add_public_prefix_to_tenants
description: Add tenants.public_prefix VARCHAR(20) with a UNIQUE constraint (slug-safe public tenant prefix, spec 14 R2). The tenant record is the system-of-record for the prefix; it is carried read-only to the SAM plane via the governance projection (task 6.2). DDL only — the slug-safe, collision-resolved backfill for existing tenants is the paired Python step migrations/backfill_tenant_public_prefix.py (run once against the resolved DB target). The column is nullable so MySQL permits multiple pre-backfill NULLs under the UNIQUE index. MySQL 9.4: no IF NOT EXISTS on indexes — idempotency comes from the migration tracker, not SQL syntax.
